facts.fact: Thulasi (a salt-boiler's daughter, from the intake roll glimpse) is among the forty Neela calls by name.
facts.why: needed because she names members from the plank during the hunt; the name comes from F563.

facts.fact: Ammu's blue Valli cloth and cord pouch, weighted with a flat stone, still lie at the roots of the blackbark tree where she died.
facts.why: needed because the tree is recognised by them; follows F257 and F408.

facts.fact: A fox-sized animal bites Neela's left calf and another bites Devan's left thigh; each bite opens identically on the other through the wound-share.
facts.why: needed because the beat says both bleed from the same bites.

facts.fact: Neela promises Twenty-two that her roll will be read at noon in the sun, only if she wants it, with whoever she chooses present.
facts.why: needed because she calls members by name and offers it as a way to make them break off; consistent with the choose-then-read plan of ch 28.
